resources.string: Shows a big, fixed bar with Back and Home buttons at the bottom of the screen, over the phone\'s own navigation buttons. It is a navigation aid for older people and people with cognitive or motor impairments who find the small system buttons or swipe gestures hard to use. It only notices when windows change (to step aside for the lock screen and, if the helper sets it up, to keep the pull-down menu closed while the home screen is locked) and, if the helper sets it up, presses of the volume buttons (to lock and unlock with a pattern, and to limit the volume while locked); it ignores every other key, cannot read what is on the screen, and sends nothing anywhere.
✗ The bar is turned on but not running.
A big bar with Back and Home sits at the bottom of the screen, in every app, over the phone\'s own buttons.
Turn on “Back & Home” in accessibility settings.
Android has stopped it. Tap the button below, open \"Back & Home\", switch it off and on again.
Android says “Restricted setting”? Allow it in App info first.
Locked from the home screen. Unlock it there to change settings.
The bar is paused by automation: another app (for example Trigly) has hidden it for now. It comes back when that app shows it again, or with the button below.
Now: Back on the left, Home on the right.
Now: Home on the left, Back on the right.
The navigation mode of this phone could not be read.
Good: the bar sits exactly over the phone\'s own buttons.
Choose 3-button navigation: then the bar sits exactly over the phone\'s own buttons.
✓ The bar is on, hidden while unlocked. It comes back when the phone is locked.

When you unlock the home screen with its PIN (or the pattern below), the bar steps aside, so you can use the phone\'s own buttons. It comes back when you lock again. Only once a PIN has been set on the home screen.
Pulling down notifications and quick settings from the top edge.
Works only once a PIN is set on the home screen (SeniorLauncher).
Some phones can still open the menu another way.
“Swipe fingerprint for notifications” is on: it can still open the menu.

Press Volume Up and Down in your own pattern to lock or unlock the home screen and the other Senior apps: 4 to 6 presses, up and down mixed, within 3 seconds and at most 1 second apart. The volume goes back to where it was afterwards. Works while the screen is on and the bar is turned on, not during a call.
This needs the Senior home screen (SeniorLauncher), in a current version.
Set a PIN on the home screen first (Settings, Lock); the pattern locks with that PIN.
Press the volume buttons now, 4 to 6 times, up and down mixed.
Use 4 to 6 presses, with at least one Up and one Down.
Set a PIN on the home screen first
While the phone rings or during a call the buttons always work normally. Holding both buttons is Android\'s accessibility shortcut and is not affected.
Also when the volume is changed in another way, for example with the slider, it is brought back into these limits.
If the phone is switched to silent while locked, the ring can only be turned back on with Do Not Disturb access. Allow it for \"Back & Home\".

Keeps this app\'s settings in a file you choose, for example in Downloads or on Google Drive. Load the file again after a reset or on a new phone. The bar itself is switched on again in Accessibility settings.
Replace the current settings with the ones from the file?
This file is not a readable settings file. Nothing was changed.
This file comes from a newer version of the app. Please update the app first. Nothing was changed.
This file holds no settings for %1$s. Nothing was changed.
The file could not be read. Nothing was changed.
The file could not be saved.

string-array.name: steps_a11y
string-array.item: Tap “Open accessibility settings” below.
Tap “Back & Home”. It is under “Downloaded apps”.
Turn on “Use Back & Home”.
Android asks whether to allow full control: tap “Allow”.

string-array.name: steps_a11y_notes
string-array.item: Samsung: “Back & Home” is under “Installed apps”.
The app says “turned on but not running”? Turn “Use Back & Home” off and on again.

string-array.name: steps_a11y_notes_restricted
string-array.item: Android says “Restricted setting”? Tap “Open App info” below, tap ⋮ at the top right, tap “Allow restricted settings”, then start again at step 1. Needed when the app was not installed from Google Play.
Samsung: “Back & Home” is under “Installed apps”.
The app says “turned on but not running”? Turn “Use Back & Home” off and on again.

string-array.name: steps_nav
string-array.item: Tap “Open navigation settings” below.
Tap “3-button navigation”.
Come back here: it says “This phone uses 3-button navigation.”

string-array.name: steps_nav_notes
string-array.item: Only the Settings list opened? Tap “System”, then “Navigation mode”.
Samsung: “Display”, then “Navigation bar”, then “Buttons”.

string-array.name: steps_dnd
string-array.item: Tap “Allow Do Not Disturb access” below.
Tap “Back & Home” in the list.
Turn on “Allow Do Not Disturb”.
Tap “Allow”.

string-array.name: steps_dnd_notes
string-array.item: The list did not open? In Settings: “Apps”, “Special app access”, “Do Not Disturb access”.

resources.string: Turn off other ways to the menu

string-array.name: steps_ways
string-array.item: Tap “Open system settings” below.
Tap “Gestures”.
“Swipe fingerprint for notifications”: turn it off.
“One-handed mode”: turn it off, or under “Swipe down to” choose “Pull screen into reach”.
Come back here.

string-array.name: steps_ways_notes
string-array.item: Not listed? This phone does not have that gesture.
Only the Settings list opened? Tap “System”, then “Gestures”.
Samsung: “Advanced features”, then “Motions and gestures”, then turn off “Finger sensor gestures” (if listed).
“Swipe down anywhere” on the home screen (Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus) belongs to the phone’s own home screen app: it does not apply while SeniorLauncher is the home screen.
